baseline_reference.rule: Reference only; this pack never replaces trusted or vehicle evidence.

claims.action_if_connected: Select by explicit model and year, then probe presence and identity before candidate reads.
claims.promotion_test: Reproduce each route and decoder on project hardware and bind it to stable ECU identity.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Do not treat service-21 and service-22 generations as interchangeable.

claims.exact_claim: Immutable Prius source data carries modern hybrid-control reads on 7D2/7DA and battery-pack reads on 747/74F.
claims.action_if_connected: Probe exact routes only after Prius/year classification.
claims.promotion_test: Capture stable identity and validate signals against independent references.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Prius source scope; no automatic Toyota-wide inheritance.

claims.exact_claim: Immutable Lexus RX data contains service-21 engine reads for 2010/2013 vehicles and service-22 hybrid reads for 2025.
